scope: Initial buddy interior target preference cost
sourceIntent: LAMBS doAssault preserves useful native movement and uses occupancy-aware destinations; it is an individual assault helper, not a coordinated building-clearance protocol. CBE retains separate paired interior targets and finite native path attempts.
finding: Initial buddy straight-line connectivity preference could run up to24 geometry queries per pair outside the room callback budget. This was preference only: fallback already attempted a native node when rays were blocked.
implementation: At most4 preference probes per pair, consuming the existing16 room geometry budget only while more than8 remain. Native distinct-node fallback is unchanged; no extra worker, movement command, authority or visit credit.
limits: No historical entry delay root cause established.
Physical observation budget can still be exhausted by its own bounded consumers; this change prevents optional ranking spending its reserved remainder.
No whole-mod LAMBS parity or measured runtime budget claim.
